spec 8. THE STANDING ANSWER FOR A NAMED ENTITY WHOSE ORGANISATIONAL FORM THE SOURCE DOES NOT STATE. The recipient is named and confirmed; only its form is undetermined. Code recipient_type = NONPROFIT_CBO, set determination_confidence = LOW, and carry this flag. Florida originally wrote UNCLASSIFIED for this case and Georgia wrote NONPROFIT_CBO + this flag; the Georgia convention is the adopted one and Florida was back-fitted to it, because UNCLASSIFIED is outside the spec 8 vocabulary and a second answer to one question would split Stage 5's hospital determination. NEVER use this to soften a recipient whose form IS stated.
